//==
// # Sampled fields on grids
//
// IField values stored one per grid node (lattice point), so each Values
// extent equals the grid's cell count plus one along that axis. Evaluation
// between nodes interpolates; outside the bounds, values clamp to the edge
// unless a resampling descriptor says otherwise.

// A planar scalar field stored on grid nodes; evaluation interpolates
// bilinearly. Backs heightmaps, masks, and discretized potentials.
type SampledScalarGrid2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Grid: RegularGrid2D;
    Values: Array2D<Number>;
}
